leaves.split_basis: Park District 2026 Appropriations p.246 Appropriation F: 11 named institutions, each = tax levy less loss in collection plus personal property replacement tax. Sum ties to $29,617,600 exactly.

pieces.name: Peggy Notebaert Nature Museum (Chicago Academy of Sciences)
DuSable Museum of African American History
Institute of Puerto Rican Arts and Culture (IPRAC)

leaves.why_cant_go_deeper: State law sets one payment for each of 11 museums, and the largest is $4.6M, so there is nothing smaller to show.

leaves.split_basis: Ordinance footnote (p.246): Other Expense includes $10M of TIF surplus capital. Budget message (p.7): $5M funds Chicago Grows Together (16 parks, $200K to $500K each, total $5,000,000, data/parks_capital_projects.json) and $5M funds priority infrastructure (fieldhouse air conditioning, lead service line replacement, ADA upgrades for polling sites; no dollars per item). Residual $523,042 is derived.

pieces.name: Chicago Grows Together: 16 parks x $200K to $500K
Priority infrastructure (AC, lead lines, ADA), no per-item dollars

leaves.why_cant_go_deeper: The District moved this money into its building fund, and the public plan names two $5M uses without a price for each repair.

leaves.split_basis: parks_vendors.json: SMG (ASM Global) holds P-12035 Soldier Field and McFetridge, P-15018 Beverly/Morgan Park. The ERP payee list gives one SMG total ($40.6M in 2022 for accounts 626045, 626055, 626065), not by facility. The 2026 budget line is $36.3M for Soldier Field alone. No fee schedule is attached to the Legistar matters.

pieces_over_10m_after.name: SMG management of Soldier Field (one contract P-12035)

leaves.why_cant_go_deeper: One company runs Soldier Field for the Park District, and the District does not publish what it pays that company for each job.

leaves.split_basis: parks_vendors.json: Westrec Marinas (P-14010) is the only payee mapped to harbor management ($11.5M in 2022). One contract.
leaves.why_cant_go_deeper: One company runs all the boat harbors, and the District does not publish what it pays for each harbor.

leaves.split_basis: parks_vendors.json: water and sewer payee not identified (probably the City of Chicago, 2022 list shows $18.9M to unmapped City of Chicago payees).
